# Session files reference

Structure of the files under `.migent/sessions/<id>/` and of every `events.jsonl` record.
Objects are open: readers must ignore unknown fields.

Each entry has a stability class.
`guaranteed`: a breaking change needs a major release, and a format change bumps `schema_version` and adds a union member.
`known`: an opt-in description, never a guarantee.

<a id="session-event-json"></a>

### Session event envelope (`events.jsonl`)

Schema: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodeint/migent/main/packages/contracts/schemas/session/event.json`

Every line of `events.jsonl`.
The per-event records are `session/event/<name>`.

Path:
`events.jsonl`; class: guaranteed; framing: json-lines

Type: [Lifecycle event (v2)](cli-output.md#known-lifecycle-event-v2-json) \| [Lifecycle event (unversioned or v1)](cli-output.md#known-lifecycle-event-legacy-json)

## Events

One record schema per event name.
Client events (`provider.*`, `verify.*` and the correction events) accept a current and a historical form.
